import json
prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def uni(vals):
        return len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != 0
    vcols = [j for j in range(w) if uni([grid[i][j] for i in range(h)])]
    hrows = [i for i in range(h) if uni([grid[i][j] for j in range(w)])]
    vc = vcols[0] if vcols else None
    hr = hrows[0] if hrows else None
    if vc is not None:
        H = hr if hr is not None else h
        if len(vcols) >= 2:
            b = [list(r[vcols[0]+1:vcols[1]]) for r in grid[:H]]
            bw = vcols[1] - vcols[0] - 1
        else:
            bg = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
            left = [v for r in grid[:H] for v in r[:vc]]
            right = [v for r in grid[:H] for v in r[vc+1:]]
            nl = sum(1 for v in left if v != bg)
            nr = sum(1 for v in right if v != bg)
            if nl >= nr:
                b = [list(r[:vc]) for r in grid[:H]]
                bw = vc
            else:
                b = [list(r[vc+1:]) for r in grid[:H]]
                bw = w - vc - 1
        out = []
        for i in range(h):
            r = grid[i]
            if hr is not None and i == hr:
                out.append(r)
            else:
                bi = i if hr is None or i < hr else (i - hr - 1) % H
                new = []
                j = 0
                while j < w:
                    if j in vcols:
                        new.append(r[j]); j += 1
                    else:
                        new.extend(b[bi][:bw]); j += bw
                out.append(new)
        return out
    if hr is not None:
        return grid
    return grid
'''
